description.en: The unique identifier of the workspace. For more information, see [AgentKey](~~2587494~~).

description.zh:
任务唯一ID


> TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话。
>
description.en:
The unique ID of the task.

> The system automatically generates the TaskId. This parameter does not need to be specified. If subsequent tasks use the same TaskId, they are grouped into the same conversation.
